svg.title: Friction between crate and surface
svg.desc: A crate moves or attempts to move right, while friction acts left at the contact surface. A magnified inset shows rough upper and lower surfaces touching at their peaks. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Static friction adjusts until the crate slips
Blue: push. Red: friction magnitude. 10 kg crate; g = 10 m/s², μₛ = 0.5, μₖ = 0.3.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
